head_commit.message:
T-3366: 1936 Prairie's verandah takes its iron rail across the openings (#1681)

* T-3366: 1936 Prairie's verandah takes its iron rail across the openings, off the photograph

Piece 1 of T-3357 (the code and records cite T-3357, the ticket it was
built under before the split). corner_porch takes an optional rail key: a
square iron bar across each front arch at a height over the porch's floor,
on 0-3 standards an opening. 1936's three openings take the photograph's
dark bar at 0.8 m on one standard each. The other K01 meshes are re-emitted
byte-identical (inputs hash only).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Lap onto dev: generated files regenerated, not merged

The five files a tool owns conflict on every merge and are never hand-merged —
ticket.mjs board, publish.sh and compile_scene rewrite them from source. Nothing
in this branch's own diff was touched.

Merge drivers registered from dev rather than from this branch, so a branch cut
before T-0831 resolves the same way one cut after it does (T-0857).

---------

Co-authored-by: polecat-steward <steward@polecat.live>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
